notes:
- Sua loi tu cap nhat: bo cai khong bao gio chay do sai co Windows (DETACHED_PROCESS thay vi CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE) nen UAC khong hien va script cai dat treo vo hinh.
- Vong cho app thoat dung ping thay timeout (timeout can console moi chay duoc).
- Bo cai duoc xin quyen Administrator dung cach qua PowerShell Start-Process -Verb RunAs.
- Hop thoai bao truoc khi cai duoc chuyen len truoc, app thoat han roi moi cai.
